Tooltip_LW_NeedParts: Requires electronics scrap and electric wire.
Tooltip_LW_NeedWater: Requires half a litre of water.
Tooltip_LW_NeedOutdoor: Must be installed under the open sky.
Tooltip_LW_NeedWall: Must be mounted on a wall.
Tooltip_LW_Occupied: There is already a Live Wire device here.
Tooltip_LW_NotABattery: This is not a usable battery.
Tooltip_LW_TooGood: This battery is in good condition already.
Tooltip_LW_NeedOverhaul: Only an overhaul can improve it further.
Tooltip_LW_VoltageTester: Right-click a tile to measure its power.
Tooltip_LW_SolarPanelKit: Source. Install it under the open sky (Electrical 3).
Tooltip_LW_WindTurbineKit: Source. Install it under the open sky, higher is better (Electrical 6).
Tooltip_LW_InverterKit: Converts the power of the sources and batteries for the house. 1500 W (Electrical 5).
Tooltip_LW_BreakerKit: Mounted on a wall: an overload no longer damages the inverter (Electrical 3).
Tooltip_LW_DeepCycleBattery: Stores 1.5 kWh and lasts four times longer than a car battery.
